title: A label-free wall-tilt (treadmilling) drive does not make ring-walled Allen-Cahn cells swim: <= 1.6 BL at every setting that survives
summary: Tried to replace ringswim's per-body (label) phoretic drift with a local drive in the Allen-Cahn tilt: the wall advances where the cross-wall-averaged substrate is above the cell-scale wall mean and retracts where it is below. With a_s = 0, 3, 5, 7, 10 (seed 1, 128^2, T=10000) no track exceeds 1.6 body lengths; a_s >= 5 thins the population to 0-5 cells (a_s=7: a small cluster drifts together while its cells barely move). Two simpler forms killed all cells (they drain the depleted interior or hollow the wall from inside).
